name: browser-use
headline: Universal Agents - Standardize AI Agent
short_description: Universal Agents standardizes AI agent configurations across coding assistants. Developers benefit from a shared AGENTS.md file for consistent agent setups. It connects to AI coding assistants like Claude, Codex, and Gemini, streamlining workflows.
author: leochiu-a

sections.overview:
Universal Agents provides a lightweight standard for sharing agent configurations across multiple AI coding assistants through a single AGENTS.md manifest file. It solves platform fragmentation by defining a universal protocol that works with Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, and future AI assistants without tool-specific boilerplate. The system organizes reusable skills (task workflows) and rules (domain guidelines) in a .agents/ folder, making configurations versionable and shareable across teams. Developers initialize projects with an npx CLI, then scaffold skills and rules that any compatible agent can read and execute. This eliminates locked-in configurations and enables consistent workflows regardless of which AI assistant developers choose.
Standardize code review workflows across team members using different AI assistants
Share API design guidelines and React conventions as reusable rules
Scaffold production-ready task workflows that work in Claude Code and Cursor
Version-control agent configurations alongside project code
This file standardizes agent configurations for the E-Commerce API Redesign project, ensuring consistency across [AI_ASSISTANT_NAME] setups.
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/leochiu-a/universal-agents`
sections.usage:
```
Generate a standardized AGENTS.md configuration file for [PROJECT_NAME]. Include agent roles for [ROLE_1], [ROLE_2], and [ROLE_3]. Define their permissions, tools, and constraints. Format the file for compatibility with [AI_ASSISTANT_NAME] (e.g., Claude, Codex, or Gemini). Ensure the file follows the Universal Agents specification for cross-platform use.
```
Copy

```
```markdown
# AGENTS.md - Project: E-Commerce API Redesign

1. Place this file in the root directory of the project.
2. Configure your AI assistant to load this file at startup.
3. Use the agent roles to delegate tasks (e.g., 'Ask the backend-architect to design the product catalog API').
4. Update this file whenever project requirements or constraints change.
```
```
requirements: Claude Code or compatible AI agent
